meaning:
ὑπο νοέω, -ῶ
[in LXX: Da TH Dan.7:25 (סְבַר), Tob.8:16, Jdth.14:14, Sir.23:21 * ;]
to suspect, conjecture: Act.25:18; with accusative and inf., Act.13:25 27:27.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: As John was fulfilling his course, he said, ‘What do you suppose that I am? I am not he. But behold, one comes after me, the sandals of whose feet I am not…
